title: IBM Sterling B2B Integrator 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1 and 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1, and IBM Sterling File Gateway…
description: IBM Sterling B2B Integrator versions 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1 and 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1, as well as IBM Sterling File Gateway versions 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1 and 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1 Standard Edition, contain an improper authorization vulnerability. This flaw could allow a remote authenticated attacker to access unauthorized pages within the affected products.
